name: Trödelmarkt Ruhr Park Bochum
facts: 11:00–17:00, on car park P1 at the Westfield RuhrPark shopping centre
organiser says more than ten thousand visitors come each month
second-hand electricals, collectables, used and new clothing, new stock, from private and commercial sellers
a food row with crêpes, coffee, waffles, cake, hot dogs, döner, bratwurst, currywurst and steak
less than five minutes from the A40, signposted visitor parking next to the market
bus 336 stop Ruhr Park Brücke, bus 364 stop Ruhr Park, bus 368 stop Bochum Ruhr Park
notes: The organiser's text says first Sunday of the month, but its own date list does not follow that: 2026-10-03 is a Saturday (Tag der Deutschen Einheit) paired with Sunday 2026-10-04, and November falls on the second Sunday (08.11.). Used the listed dates, not the stated rhythm. The list ends 2026-12-06, so January 2027 is not published yet. No visitor entry fee stated on the site, so fee is null. Coordinates are the shopping centre address; car park P1 is a few hundred metres from that point.

description.de: Ein Sonntag im Monat von 11 bis 17 Uhr auf dem Parkplatz P1 am Westfield RuhrPark. Gebrauchte Elektronik, Sammlerstücke, Kleidung und Neuware, von privaten und gewerblichen Verkäufern; der Veranstalter zählt über zehntausend Besucher im Monat. Eine Essensreihe gehört dazu. Fünf Minuten von der A40.
description.en: One Sunday a month from 11 to 5 on car park P1 at the Westfield RuhrPark. Second-hand electricals, collectables, clothing and new stock from private and commercial sellers; the organiser counts more than ten thousand visitors a month. There is a row of food stalls. Five minutes from the A40.
